name: Robots.txt Utils
description: Submodule of Htaccess that deletes the physical robots.txt file (on form save and on cron) so the Robotstxt module's dynamic version is served.
project_description: Robots.txt Utils is a submodule shipped with the Htaccess project. It depends on the contrib Robotstxt module and alters that module's settings form (robotstxt_admin_settings) to add a 'Delete physical robots.txt' checkbox. When enabled, a custom submit handler removes DRUPAL_ROOT/robots.txt on save, and hook_cron() removes it again on every cron run while the Robotstxt module is enabled. The purpose is to guarantee that no stale physical robots.txt file on disk shadows the dynamically generated robots.txt that the Robotstxt module produces.
